findings.summary: The right panel is titled '(b) one classifier, asked at two ages' while the left panel carries no '(a)' label, so a reader is shown the second half of a lettered pair and looks for a first panel that the figure never marks. The left panel is not untitled by design - it has an axis unit and no designation - so the two panels do not read as one lettered pair. Does not hold the node: every panel is still readable, and each is self-describing from its axis and block text.

RECORDED = '#8a8a8a' is the colour of both the plotted step line and four pieces of label text ('record read: waiting' at line 193, the 'the recorded event leads' box at line 269, 'latest watcher 02:54:21Z waiting' at line 278 and 'answer: waiting' at line 293). Measured on the render, that grey is 3.45:1 against white, which clears the ~3:1 a data mark needs but not the 4.5:1 normal-size text needs, so the labels carrying the figure's reading are its lowest-contrast text. Does not hold the node: at 14 pt the words are plainly legible in the delivered PNG. A text-only change of the label colour would leave the data line as it is.

read_only: no file was edited, created, moved, deleted, redrawn, relabelled or reformatted; the guard controls ran on copies under the run scratch

rubric_verdicts.contrast: defect - the grey used for text is #8a8a8a and renders at 3.45:1 on white, below the 4.5:1 that normal-size text needs; measured from the rendered pixels of 'record read: waiting' (core colour #8A8A8A, 251 px) and it is the same colour the data line uses (see finding 2). The red #b0564f annotation (4.89:1), the blue #2f6fb3 (5.19:1) and the near-black #222222 all clear it
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: pass - the recorded state is one 2.6 pt step line plus a 2.4 pt dashed carry-forward; the right panel is the mechanism the caption describes, drawn in outline with no fill competing with the data
rubric_verdicts.decoration: pass - no gradient, no background fill, no shaded band and no styled theme; the box facecolour is white and borders are hairline, so nothing is drawn that does not name a state or a call site
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: pass - no label is clipped, no two labels overlap, and no label sits on the plotted line, checked against the render and against the source that refuses such a figure
rubric_verdicts.legibility: pass - at 1400 px the state labels, tick times, axis unit, the red annotation and both panel blocks are all readable; the step line and the marker are distinguishable at a glance
rubric_verdicts.table_form: pass - the left panel is a recorded time series and the right panel is a fan-in flow whose subject is the shared classifier node; a table of two call sites would not show the convergence the caption is about

verification.collision_guard_is_live: the source refuses to save a figure whose labels leave the canvas, collide, or sit on a plotted line. Control: the unmodified script ran and wrote its SVG (EXIT=0). Mutation: 'record read: waiting' moved from (3.55, waiting+0.35) to (3.0, waiting) put it over the carry-forward line and the guard refused, printing "label sits on the plotted line: 'record read: waiting'" (EXIT=1). A first mutation that lowered the label to the same y without moving x did not refuse, because at x=3.55 the label clears the line's end at x=3.41 - recorded here because a mutation that does not reach the guarded condition proves nothing.
